GREG P0 (verbatim via Asistant #1543, 2026-11-13 16:05Z): closing unified Execution Observability „to jest nasze P0”. Both projects sync, no unassigned work left deferred, and restarts go to Greg through Asistant as a clear RESET NOW.
Epic w-3fe8f4472e5d: 8 reconcile children, ALL assigned at 16:07Z ahead of closures and lower work:
- w-d1818c0d174d (P1): 8e1f, now.
- w-a3ed3fd4d50d, then w-e1fc1595d96c (P1): d50d, now.
- w-79cb2894b78f (P1 research), then w-90de8de3e8d6 (P3 docs): Opus3, now. Opus3 also drafts the criterion-6 per-harness restart checklist on the epic.
- w-3ab66c26d9e3 (P1): 03d4, after P0 w-492e lands.
- w-657d74d6944b (P3): edfd, after the 0419 re-cut.
- w-327a67e8f9df (P4): a7bb, after the w-a6f5 measurement and slice 1's pair.
Criterion 6: live evidence after the cutover restart, through Engram's ordinary writer, for Codex/Claude/Cursor/Gemini/OpenCode/Kimi. Needs live sessions per harness. Plan ONE coordinated restart with Engram::Fable (asked in ebe242f7 #7812).
Related, outside the epic: w-1fd8f197b596 (legacy census), w-3ed252d21d84 (authority wording; instruction-file process), w-f83094005168, w-b8d04dff6b68.
content-v1: zero in production; ~30 old-shape test files and 2 docs remain.
The in-flight landings K3 S2b and then P0 w-492e finish as planned.

16:20Z TRAIN RULE for EO P0 items (Fable2 to Opus2 #5919): an EO item enters the landing train directly behind the last change whose review pair is already RUNNING or COMPLETE, ahead of any non-EO change whose pair hasn't started. It never voids a running or completed pair.
Current train: P0 1bf874d9 > K3 slice 1 05062f47 > EO 327a (a7bb, cut on 05062f47) > 0419 (edfd re-cuts on 327a) > ee04.
Status at 16:20Z:
- 79cb: evaluation admitted (session-17858).
- 90de: met, with evaluation queued.
- a3ed: no-op reconciliation, evaluation requested.
- d181: repair already on master; its C3 "lands inside w-3fe8 final candidate through its review pair and full gate" is blocked on Greg's answer to Asistant #1548 (accept a fresh review pair plus a current FULL).
- 3ab6: implementing per ruling note 2857093f (remove the pre-send Engram held-binding read; local S0 stays).
- 657d: edfd checking.
- 327a: staged.
- e1fc: d50d next.
Harnesses:
- Cursor: root session-17857 created.
- Gemini: needs auth from Greg.
- OpenCode: not on Central; DL560 and Mac being probed.
